They disagree on one point: glm says the log "ends abruptly", and sonnet says that claim is not supported because the tail was cut where the log was anchored.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5493-5536 | severity=high | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: The alt-model artifact cleanup reads at most 5 pages of the repo-wide runs list, so it can miss pending Implement runs once the page cap is reached.
  WHY: If more than 500 runs exist after the issue's creation time, older pending Implement runs are never cancelled and may later open new PRs for the closed issue.

  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When the tracking-issue state read fails, the sweep backstop falls back to the PR age rule alone.
  WHY: This fail-open behaviour is intended, but it means some PRs are closed based on issue state and others are not, depending on API connectivity.
